BOSTON, Sept. 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Tango Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ: TNGX) (“Tango Therapeutics” or the “Company”) today announced that members of the management team are scheduled to participate in a fireside chat at the 2026 Cantor Global Healthcare Conference on Wednesday, September 9, 2026 at 8:35 AM EDT.


The live webcast will be available under the "Events & Presentations" tab on the “Investors” page of the Company's website on the day of the event. A replay of the webcast will be archived on the Company's website for 90 days following the presentation.


**About Tango Therapeutics**
Tango Therapeutics is a clinical-stage biotechnology company dedicated to discovering novel drug targets and delivering the next generation of precision medicine for the treatment of cancer. Using an approach that starts and ends with patients, Tango leverages the genetic principle of synthetic lethality to discover and develop therapies that take aim at critical targets in cancer.
